description: This file defines the 'Assert' utility class for performing various validation checks, such as type assertions, null and emptiness checks, to facilitate argument validation in Java code.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for assertion checks, including type validation and null/empty checks.

methods.name: isAssignableTo
methods.description: Checks if an argument can be assigned to a specified target class, throws IllegalArgumentException if not.

methods.name: isInstanceOf
methods.description: Verifies if an argument is an instance of a specified class.

methods.name: isInstanceOf
methods.description: Verifies if an argument matches any of multiple specified classes.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf
methods.description: Ensures an argument is not an instance of a specific class.

methods.name: isNotInstanceOf
methods.description: Ensures an argument is not an instance of any listed classes.

methods.name: notEmpty
methods.description: Validates that a String is not null or empty.

methods.name: notEmpty
methods.description: Validates that a Map is not null or empty.

methods.name: notEmpty
methods.description: Validates that a Collection is not null or empty.

methods.name: notEmpty
methods.description: Validates that an array is not null or empty.

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Validates that all provided arguments are not null.

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Validates that a single argument is not null.
